name: Ethos ~Tenshi no Furu Basho~
source:
Main character meets a mysterious girl in strange clothes during his part-time job. She turns out to be an angel who now sheds her light to the people. So their unusual cohabitation begins. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-may-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公打工时遇见一名穿着奇特服装的神秘女孩。原来她是一名正向人们洒下光芒的天使。于是，两人开始了不同寻常的同居生活。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-may-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
